name: SN 2020bjk field (Hubble)
blurb: The field of the supernova SN 2020bjk, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2020bjkfield-hubble
story: Hubble returned to the place where the Type Ia supernova SN 2020bjk exploded, long after the blast, to measure the radioactive material it left behind and to study its surroundings.

claims.text: SN 2020bjk is a Type Ia supernova
Hubble program 16239 takes late-time snapshots of recent supernovae to measure radioactive material and probe their environments
